title: オーシャンSの後に・カワイイの秘策

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan runs well in the Ocean Stakes, and the response to her Cutie ♪ Derby is also excellent.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, her next opponent, Biko Pegasus, boasts far more popularity than her on UmaTok.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Curren Chan has a secret plan, though she keeps it to herself as we proceed to the first round of the Cutie ♪ Derby—the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.
